title: Research on a small-concentration chemical oxygen demand prediction algorithm based on an enhanced parrot optimizer–BPNN and ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00882D, Paper
Hongmei Wang, Qiaoling Du, Xin Wang
The core innovation breaks the BPNN parameter optimization bottleneck via LHS initialization, PRB position update, and CAW individual elimination. It enables accurate detection of low-concentration COD under low-turbidity interference.
